title: Company Picnic
one_paragraph_synopsis: During the company picnic, the Dunder Mifflin Scranton branch experiences a mix of lighthearted moments and serious conflicts. Michael falls asleep after overeating, prompting the office to quietly change the clocks to leave early. At the picnic, Jim and Pam plan a brief visit while sharing humorous memories. Michael interacts with Holly and her boyfriend AJ, and later performs a comedy sketch with Holly that unexpectedly announces the closure of the Buffalo branch, causing upset among employees and confrontation with David. Meanwhile, the Scranton team competes in volleyball, advancing despite injuries, including Pam's, which leads to disagreements about her continuing to play and efforts to stall the opposing team. The episode ends with unresolved questions about the volleyball game outcome, Pam's injury severity, and the impact of the branch closure announcement.
